task.goal: Create a lead for Acme Corp (contact Jane Roe) assigned to Priya Shah, then report the lead ID.

environment.faultDescription: The session expires after the new-lead form is served. The POST is rejected with a redirect to /login; nothing is saved until the agent re-authenticates and resubmits.

agent.description: Naive baseline: one observation, index-based targets, cached selector, retries errors blindly, trusts the toast.

claim.summary: Submitted the lead for Acme Corp; the session was refreshed afterwards.

notes: The application, its seed data and the injected fault are rebuilt from this manifest; the original network traffic is not replayed.
Fault timings are derived from the seed, so the race is re-created rather than recorded.
Scripted agents are deterministic; an LLM agent must be replayed with its recorded model outputs or judged over repeated trials (pass^k).
